mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS currentDatetime, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'YYYYMMDD') AS currentDate, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'HH24MISS') AS currentTime, A.current_time AS currentTimestamp, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'YYYY') AS currentYear, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'MM') AS currentMonth, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'DD') AS currentDay, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'HH24') AS currentHour, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'MI') AS currentMinute FROM (SELECT NOW() AS current_time ) AS A

SELECT A.MENU_ID, A.MENU_NM, A.NPAG_YN, A.ANCT_MENU_ID AS UP_MENU_ID, A.SORT_SEQ AS SORT_SN FROM cdm_own.MENU A, cdm_own.MENU_AUTH B WHERE A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID AND B.AUTH_CD = #{authrtCd} ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ, A.ANCT_MENU_ID

SELECT COALESCE(sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_cntn_idnty_dt))),0) AS seconds_difference FROM cdm_own.cmpt_user_lgn_hstry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND lgn_ymd = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')

select user_id from ( select usr.usr_id AS user_id ,COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_cntn_idnty_dt)),0) AS seconds_difference from cdm_own.cmpt_user_lgn_hstry lgn inner join cdm_own.usr usr on usr.usr_id = lgn.user_id where lgn.lgn_ymd = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') and usr.lgn_yn = 'Y' ) auto_login where seconds_difference > (60 * 1 * 10)
